description:
FILED s521 (Fable, 2026-10-18 15:5x) from the CPAN-board failure review (docs/cpan-board-failure-review-s521.md Â§2d, Â§3): the review found that #3327's 438 Capture-Tiny rows (capture_merged / tee_merged "multiline" and "unicode" assertions) are each a separate `like($got, qr/\Q$expected\E/)` that output ORDER cannot fail; they fail because the pattern never matches when `$expected` holds a newline.  Fable re-probed on main c128e454:

    my $e = "A:b\nC d\n"; my $s = "xx A:b\nC d\n yy";
    print(($s =~ qr/\Q$e\E/) ? "m1" : "n1");         # perl m1   PCL n1
    my $e3 = "Hi!\n"; print(("Hi!\n" =~ /\Q$e3\E/) ? "m3" : "n3");   # perl m3   PCL n3
    print(("a.b" =~ /^\Qa.b\E$/) ? "m4" : "n4");     # both m4 (no newline)

CAUSE (read by the review, not yet fixed): cl/pcl-runtime.lisp `perl-regex-to-ppcre` (~36565) applies `\Q...\E` at RUN time with a rewrite whose `.` does not cross a newline and whose `$` stops before a final one -- so a quoted run containing "\n" is left as literal backslash-Q text.  This is the SAME pass #2501 names: `\Q...\E` is a DOUBLE-QUOTED-STRING operator (toke.c), applied when the pattern LITERAL is interpolated, never by the regex compiler -- a run-time pattern text holding a literal backslash-Q is the letter Q in perl (`my $p = q(^\Qa.b\E$); "a.b" =~ /$p/` is 0 in perl, 1 in PCL).

RULED (Fable, s521, DECIDED ## s521): fix in #2501's SHAPE -- `\Q...\E` is applied where the literal is compiled (Pl/InterpScan.pm's regex consumer, as the dq decoder already does for strings, ir-spec Â§3.2g: the quoted run becomes a `quotemeta` of the interpolated text), and the runtime `\Q` pass is DELETED, which closes #2501 in the same member.  The one-line repair of the runtime regex (`(?s)` + `\z`) is a documented FALLBACK only if the literal-path port does not fit the member's budget -- then this task closes and #2501 stays open, and the report says so.  Probe BEFORE and AFTER vs perl: `qr/\Q$e\E/` with a newline; `m/\Qa.b/` (no \E: quoting runs to the end); `/\Q$x/`; `s/\Q$a\E/b/`; `split /\Q$d\E/, $s`; `tr` untouched; `\Q` inside a character class `[\Q.]\E]`; `"\Q$x\E"` in a dq STRING (already right, must stay); a pattern from a VARIABLE holding backslash-Q (`q(^\Qa.b\E$)`: perl 0|1 -- #2501's own line); `\Q$x\E` where $x holds `\E`; `\L\Q$x\E` nesting; `qr//` objects interpolated into another pattern (`/$qr\Q$y\E/`).  An EMISSION change on every literal holding `\Q` -- corpus-diff / emission-ab every differing file explained; gen bump; the FULL SWEEP (`re/` files: perl-tests pat.t regexp.t and the companion's re/ leg are the population).

ACCEPTANCE: the three probe lines = perl; Capture-Tiny one-file runs (`tools/run-dist-t.pl --rows ~/.cpan/build/Capture-Tiny-0.50-0 t/02-capture.t`, 03-tee, 08-stdin-closed, 12-stdin-string): the 288 "multiline" rows pass and leave baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv by edit citing this task (the 150 "unicode" rows need #3326 too -- re-cause them to #3326 if they still fail after this fix); #3327 RE-SCOPED by edit to the real residue it observed (STDERR before STDOUT in a merged capture -- a flush-order divergence no blessed row asserts); a guard row in the Pl/t regex file that holds the `\Q` rows (grep `\\Q` Pl/t), inverse-verified; ir-spec Â§3.2g one sentence.


=== DONE (s521b, 2026-10-18, commit de3a6148 -- #2501's SHAPE, as ruled) ===
`\U \L \F \Q \E \u \l` in a REGEX literal go through Pl::CaseMods -- THE case-escape machine, now shared with the dq decoder
(StringInterpolation.pm refactored onto it, rule 11) -- in ExprToCL::_regex_case_mod_pattern (m//, qr//, split, the s/// pattern):
a group covers the pattern's RAW text (perl: `/\Qa\nb/` matches backslash-n; probed) with an escaped non-bracketing delimiter undone
(`m!\Qa\!b!`), plus each interpolated reference's run-time value; an ASCII literal group folds at compile time (`/\Qa.b/` stays the
native literal `a\.b`); a `'` delimiter turns them off.  The runtime \Q pass in perl-regex-to-ppcre is DELETED.  BAR: the probe list
(scratch/s521b/pr/q1.pl q2.pl: newline, no \E, /\Q$x/, s///, split, [\Q.]\E], dq "\Q$x\E", the #2501 variable line, $x holding \E,
\L\Q$x\E, /$qr\Q$y\E/, delimiter, \U literal, stray \E, m'..') = perl, except `/\Qa#b\E/x` (perl strips the /x COMMENT before \Q --
pre-existing, same on ed8a4504).  Guard Pl/t/regex-interp-01.t keys Q_* + one emission row (10 FAIL on ed8a4504).  corpus-diff vs
ed8a4504: 8 files differ (bless bop infnan magic method pack split sprintf), every diff = the \Q applied at the literal.  Capture-Tiny:
the 438 #3327 rows leave (with member 1's 682 #3326 rows).  gen v2-7384.
subject: SILENT WRONG: `qr/\Q$x\E/` never matches when $x holds a NEWLINE -- the RUNTIME \Q pass in perl-regex-to-ppcre rewrites `\Q(.*?)\E` with a `.` that stops at a newline; 438 Capture-Tiny board rows blessed as #3327 ("order") fail on it; RULED fix = #2501's shape (apply \Q where the literal is compiled, delete the runtime pass)
